title: District draft houses build the same on every Python
items: The Prairie Avenue draft houses now add their storey heights and centroids one term at a time, so a build on Python 3.12 writes the same bytes as the gate's 3.11 — the 2011 Prairie turret no longer comes out different on the build machine.
The exact-sum check now counts the sums in every pure-Python building kit, so the problem cannot creep back in.
